chunks: And a saying of his (peace be upon him) when ‘Umar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb consulted him about taking part himself in fighting the Persians.

key_terms.الشخوص: taking part personally / leading in person

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali advise Umar ibn al-Khattab regarding the battle against the Persians?
ai.summary: This narration highlights the unique political dynamic where the Sunni Caliph, ‘Umar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, sought the strategic counsel of Imam ‘Alī (AS) despite their differing views on leadership, demonstrating the Imam’s recognized military and administrative acumen. The advice for ‘Umar to lead personally reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Imam’s superior insight into statecraft and the practical wisdom he offered to the early Islamic community during critical expansion periods.
